def fetch(url, path, headers=None, timeout=300):
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers=headers or {"User-Agent": UA["User-Agent"]})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=timeout) as r, open(path + ".part", "wb") as f:
        while True:
            b = r.read(1 << 20)
            if not b: break
            f.write(b)
    os.replace(path + ".part", path)

def bk_file(key):
    aid, durl = BK[key]
    p = os.path.join(ADIR, "bk_" + aid + ".blend")
    if os.path.exists(p) and os.path.getsize(p) > 1000: return p
    errs = []
    for host_url in [durl, durl.replace("www.blenderkit.com", "api.blenderkit.com")]:
        try:
            h = dict(UA); h["Authorization"] = "Bearer " + KEY
            q = host_url + "?" + urllib.parse.urlencode({"scene_uuid": str(uuid.uuid4())})
            r = urllib.request.urlopen(urllib.request.Request(q, headers=h), timeout=60)
            fp = json.loads(r.read().decode())["filePath"]
            fetch(fp, p)
            return p
        except Exception as e:
            errs.append(type(e).__name__ + ":" + str(getattr(e, "code", ""))[:6])
    NOTES.append("BK " + key + " " + "/".join(errs))
    return None

PH = "https://dl.polyhaven.org/file/ph-assets/"
def ph_tex(name, kind, res="1k"):
    ext = "jpg"
    p = os.path.join(ADIR, "ph_%s_%s_%s.jpg" % (name, kind, res))
    if not os.path.exists(p):
        try: fetch(PH + "Textures/jpg/%s/%s/%s_%s_%s.jpg" % (res, name, name, kind, res), p)
        except Exception as e:
            NOTES.append("PH " + name + kind); return None
    return p

def ph_hdri(name, res="2k"):
    p = os.path.join(ADIR, "ph_%s_%s.hdr" % (name, res))
    if not os.path.exists(p):
        try: fetch(PH + "HDRIs/hdr/%s/%s_%s.hdr" % (res, name, res), p)
        except Exception: NOTES.append("PH hdri " + name); return None
    return p

def load_objs(key, coll_name=None):
    """append all renderable objects of a Blendkit file into a new scene collection; returns (collection, objects, top-level objects)"""
    p = bk_file(key)
    if not p: return None
    with bpy.data.libraries.load(p, link=False) as (df, dt):
        dt.objects = list(df.objects)
    coll = bpy.data.collections.new(coll_name or ("BK_" + key))
    bpy.context.scene.collection.children.link(coll)
    objs = []
    for o in dt.objects:
        if o is None: continue
        if o.type in ("CAMERA", "LIGHT"): continue
        if o.hide_render and o.type != "ARMATURE": continue
        coll.objects.link(o); objs.append(o)
    names = set(o.name for o in objs)
    tops = [o for o in objs if o.parent is None or o.parent.name not in names]
    return coll, objs, tops

def bbox(objs):
    mn = Vector((1e9, 1e9, 1e9)); mx = Vector((-1e9, -1e9, -1e9))
    dg = bpy.context.evaluated_depsgraph_get()
    for o in objs:
        if o.type != "MESH": continue
        for c in o.bound_box:
            w = o.matrix_world @ Vector(c)
            mn = Vector((min(mn.x, w.x), min(mn.y, w.y), min(mn.z, w.z)))
            mx = Vector((max(mx.x, w.x), max(mx.y, w.y), max(mx.z, w.z)))
    return mn, mx

EOF_CDL

cat > probe2.py <<'EOF_P2'
import bpy, os, sys, math
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
from common_dl import *
OUTD = sys.argv[sys.argv.index("--") + 1]
for o in list(bpy.data.objects): bpy.data.objects.remove(o, do_unlink=True)
L = []
def W(*a): L.append(" ".join(str(x) for x in a))
r = load_objs("victim")
coll, objs, tops = r
for o in objs:
    if o.name.startswith("cs_"): o.hide_render = True
W("ADIR files", [f for f in os.listdir(ADIR) if not f.endswith(".blend")][:40])
seen = set()
for o in objs:
    if o.type != "MESH" or o.hide_render: continue
    W("OBJ", o.name, "mods", [(m.type, getattr(m, "object", None) and m.object.name) for m in o.modifiers], "vis", o.visible_get() if hasattr(o, "visible_get") else "")
    for s in o.material_slots:
        m = s.material
        if not m or m.name in seen: continue
        seen.add(m.name)
        W(" MAT", m.name, "method", getattr(m, "surface_render_method", ""), "blend", getattr(m, "blend_method", ""), "nodes", len(m.node_tree.nodes) if m.node_tree else 0)
        if not m.node_tree: continue
        for n in m.node_tree.nodes:
            extra = ""
            if n.type == "TEX_IMAGE" and n.image:
                im = n.image
                extra = "img=%s path=%s packed=%s has=%s size=%s cs=%s" % (im.name, im.filepath, im.packed_file is not None, im.has_data, tuple(im.size), im.colorspace_settings.name)
            if n.type == "GROUP": extra = "group=%s" % (n.node_tree.name if n.node_tree else None)
            if n.type == "BSDF_PRINCIPLED":
                extra = " ".join("%s=%s" % (k, (tuple(round(x, 2) for x in n.inputs[k].default_value) if hasattr(n.inputs[k].default_value, "__len__") else round(n.inputs[k].default_value, 2))) for k in ["Base Color", "Alpha", "Metallic", "Roughness", "Transmission Weight", "Subsurface Weight", "Emission Strength"] if k in n.inputs)
            W("   N", n.type, repr(n.name), extra)
        for lk in m.node_tree.links:
            W("   L", lk.from_node.name, lk.from_socket.name, "->", lk.to_node.name, lk.to_socket.name)
open(os.path.join(OUTD, "p2.txt"), "w").write("\n".join(L))
# render: victim lit, front camera
sc = bpy.context.scene; sc.render.engine = "BLENDER_EEVEE"
sc.eevee.taa_render_samples = 8
w = bpy.data.worlds.new("W"); sc.world = w; w.use_nodes = True; w.node_tree.nodes["Background"].inputs[0].default_value = (0.3, 0.3, 0.32, 1)
ld = bpy.data.lights.new("s", "SUN"); ld.energy = 3; so = bpy.data.objects.new("s", ld); so.rotation_euler = (math.radians(60), 0, math.radians(20)); sc.collection.objects.link(so)
cd = bpy.data.cameras.new("c"); cd.lens = 60; cam = bpy.data.objects.new("c", cd); sc.collection.objects.link(cam); sc.camera = cam
cam.location = (0.0, -3.2, 1.2); cam.rotation_euler = (math.radians(88), 0, 0)
sc.render.resolution_x, sc.render.resolution_y = 600, 900
sc.render.image_settings.file_format = "PNG"; sc.render.filepath = os.path.join(OUTD, "p2.png")
bpy.ops.render.render(write_still=True)

EOF_P2
